capabilities: List dangling links in a side panel, grouped by file, folder, or link
Navigate to each occurrence of a dangling link by clicking it
Wrap all dangling links in a chosen prefix and suffix
Create one note per dangling link from selected templates
Ignore chosen folders and collapse list items
extras: The README includes a Permissions section stating all processing runs locally and no file contents or paths leave Obsidian.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a fork of the now lightly maintained Dangling Links by Graydon Hoare.
motivation: The author used the original Dangling Links plugin for years and wanted to add features that fix common dangling-link cases.
problem: Obsidian shows unresolved links but offers no consolidated list or bulk tools to correct typos, unwrap links to deleted files, or create the missing notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a fork of the now lightly maintained Dangling Links by Graydon Hoare.

summary: Side-panel plugin that lists dangling (unresolved) links in a vault and fixes them by editing, wrapping, or creating notes from templates.
